column1: As a user, I want to register for an account so that I can access MindBridge.,Story,High,"A new user should be able to create a personal account using their email address and a password.","1. Given the user is on the registration page, When they enter a valid email address and a password meeting the requirements, Then the account is created and the user is redirected to their dashboard. 2. Given the user enters an email address already registered in the system, When they submit the form, Then an error message appears stating the email address is already in use. 3. Given the user submits the registration form with a required field left blank, When the form is submitted, Then an inline error message appears identifying which field is missing."

As a user, I want to log in to my account so that I can access my wellness goals.,Story,High,"A registered user should be able to log in using their email address and password.","1. Given the user is on the login page, When they enter a valid email and correct password and select Log In, Then they are taken to their personal dashboard. 2. Given the user enters an incorrect password, When they submit the login form, Then an error message appears stating the credentials are invalid. 3. Given the user has forgotten their password, When they select the Forgot Password link, Then they are taken to the password reset flow."

As a user, I want to reset my password so that I can regain access to my account if I forget my credentials.,Story,Medium,"A registered user should be able to request a password reset via email.","1. Given the user is on the password reset page, When they enter a registered email address and select Submit, Then a password reset link is sent to that email address within 2 minutes. 2. Given the user selects the password reset link in their email, When the link is valid and has not expired, Then they are taken to a page where they can enter and confirm a new password. 3. Given the password reset link has expired, When the user selects it, Then a message appears stating the link has expired and offering the option to request a new one."

As a user, I want to create a wellness goal so that I can track my personal progress in MindBridge.,Story,High,"A logged-in user should be able to create a new wellness goal with a title, description, and target date.","1. Given the user is on the Goals page, When they select Add New Goal and complete all required fields, Then the goal is saved and appears in their goals list. 2. Given the user attempts to save a goal without entering a title, When they select Save, Then an inline error message identifies the Title field as required. 3. Given the user enters a target date that is in the past, When they select Save, Then a validation message states that the target date must be a future date."

As a user, I want to edit an existing wellness goal so that I can update my progress or change my target.,Story,Medium,"A logged-in user should be able to edit the title, description, and target date of any goal they have previously created.","1. Given the user is on the Goals page, When they select Edit on an existing goal, Then a form opens pre-populated with the current goal details. 2. Given the user updates the goal title and selects Save, When the save is successful, Then the updated title appears immediately in the goals list. 3. Given the user clears all content from a required field and selects Save, When the form is submitted, Then an error message identifies the empty required field."

As a user, I want to mark a wellness goal as complete so that I can record my achievements.,Story,Medium,"A logged-in user should be able to mark any active goal as complete, which removes it from the active list and moves it to the completed goals section.","1. Given the user is on the Goals page, When they select Mark as Complete on an active goal, Then a confirmation prompt appears asking them to confirm the action. 2. Given the user confirms the completion, When the action is processed, Then the goal moves from the Active Goals list to the Completed Goals section. 3. Given the user has no active goals remaining, When they access the Goals page, Then a message is displayed encouraging them to create a new goal."
